One might assume that since Toegye was a major figure, maybe "the" major figure in Korean Confucianism, that the things he taught were what we see in Korea’s Confucianism today. snippet: South Korea's Nam Dong-heon won the gold medal in the individual dressage event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Sunday, bringing home the country's first Asiad title in the event in 12 years.
